svg.title: How Klieg was built
svg.desc: Three builders worked on Klieg at once: the herdr agent m1, the OpenRig rig klieg-pair with dev-build building and dev-review checking, and Claude Code on the Mac. Their work lands on main in the order it merged: the M0 skeleton, then pull requests 1 to 9, ending at the v0.1.0 release on 2026-11-01, about five hours after the skeleton.
svg.text: m1, in herdr pane w3:p1 on the herdr VM
a builder and a reviewer on the open-rig VM
on Ryan's Mac mini: everything macOS-only
in the order things merged, 2026-10-31 to 2026-11-01

g.text: M1: herdr client, timeline and CLI
M3 (part 1): live Board, Needs You and Timeline
M2: OpenRig client, GitHub client and the MCP server
M3 (part 2): OpenRig, PRs, Settings and actions in the app
M3b: Collector, and herdr agents behind the MCP tools
App: read through the shared Collector
M4: klieg mcp install, uninstall and status
about five hours after the skeleton (19:49 UTC the day before).

svg.text: Klieg watched itself being built: these agents were on its own Board.
